item.title: Hi, This Is Julian
item.description: I write dark dystopian action-adventure and fantasy fiction with many of the same or similar themes: found family, enemies to lovers or friends, the rebellious outsider, the reluctant heroine, lost magic/technology, good vs evil, and quests.
